name: Whopperflower King
description: A decorative figurine inspired by the agile and versatile Whopperflower King, vividly capturing its imposing yet nimble bearing.\nBack when the Whopperflower King was still a small Whopperflower, it wasn't very good at disguising itself as an ordinary flower. So, it spent more time honing its speed and combat skills instead. In the end, it became a Whopperflower adept at both fighting and fleeing. With its formidable strength, it no longer had to fear any opponent, even when its disguise wasn't perfect...
